course_id: Tiếng Anh - Kỹ năng Đọc Viết 3
title: English - Reading and Writing Skills 3

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop advanced reading comprehension skills at levels B2 to C1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference.
Enhance vocabulary acquisition through a variety of rich sources and apply these skills in practical contexts.
Master advanced writing skills suitable for academic and professional settings, including essay writing and data interpretation.
Improve critical thinking abilities by analyzing complex topics and applying logical reasoning.

prerequisite_courses: Tiếng Anh - Kỹ năng Đọc Viết 1
Tiếng Anh - Kỹ năng Đọc Viết 2
